create_text_transformer: create a TextTransformer model with specified vocab size, embedding dim, and number of layers
init_text_transformer_weights: initialize the TextTransformer weights using normal distribution for token and positional embeddings
run_text_transformer_forward: run a forward pass through the TextTransformer with token indices to get embeddings
build_causal_text_transformer: build a causal TextTransformer model with CausalAttentionBlock layers for autoregressive text processing
review_text_transformer_architecture: review the TextTransformer class architecture including token embedding, positional embedding, and attention blocks
